reviews.text:
I strongly advise against hiring Ron or King Pools Inc. My pool has been nothing but problems since it was built. The quality of the construction is extremely poor — everything is falling apart, tiles are cracking, and there’s a major leak that has never been properly repaired.

I’ve repeatedly reached out for help, but they either ignore me or send someone who doesn’t fix the problem. The workmanship is careless, and the company refuses to take responsibility for their mistakes. For the amount of money I paid, I expected a safe, long-lasting pool — instead, I’m left with a major headache and thousands in potential repair costs. This has been since day one. Very disappointing.

Save yourself the trouble and look elsewhere for a reputable, professional pool builder.
reviews.author: Sally De La Torre

reviews.text: We had our pool put in by King Pools and it was a great experience from start to finish. Ron King is knowledgeable, professional and he and his crew get things done. If we had questions or concerns, King Pools got back to us right away. We were always kept up to date on what was happening and, if for some reason there was going to be a delay, we were informed. For what we had done we felt that the pricing was very reasonable. The quality of the work is excellent. We highly recommend King Pools!
reviews.author: Lori Powell

reviews.text:
King pools is the best! This was our first pool build therefore we shopped many pool companies, after speaking to a few we knew this company was the right choice and boy they did not disappoint. From the start, King pools made sure we were within our budget while maximizing our smaller space and getting the small upgrades we hoped for. That lead to our decision to move forward with them however the best part was the service we received through the build of our pool. The company is family owned and every single person was so understanding of our concerns and needs. Ron answered every single one of our questions whether it was a phone call or text, his wife Kim was also super patient with my vision of the tile, and his son was very knowledgeable when it came to pool cleaning and maintenance.

I read a few reviews prior to our contract about their contractors not being the friendliest, I can assure our experience was quite the opposite. Every crew that came to our home was respectful and efficient. In addition, Ron showed up at the beginning of every new stage to ensure all was up to plan and answer any questions we had.

As if that's not enough, the project was completed way ahead of our expected date.

Overall, we are so happy with our decision and will reach out to King pools for any future builds!
reviews.author: Samantha Enriquez

reviews.text:
Our backyard Oasis has been fulfilled by King Pools. This family owned business made us feel confident this was the best investment and it has been thus far. Family pool parties, hot tub fun, girls nite out and not to mention, great place to exercise are only a few things of the many we have experienced.
From the Big dig and my last minute changes, The Kings were patient and quick to serve. If you are looking for a family oriented business relationship please contact King Pools!!!
reviews.author: Michella Young

reviews.text: I have had nothing but frustration with Ron King and King Pools. They do not do what they promise and after you follow (or attempt) they ignore you. I sent a certified letter to this business and the refused to accept it. What you are seeing in the pictures are repairs needed they now for over a year. While my build was going on the city issued a cease and desist due to them failing to ascertain the appropriate permits. Had I not taken pictures they would have again not received a green tag as they closed the walls without an inspection. I'm concerned now as I am having equipment problems - My pool is almost 3 years old now which is frightening in itself. I am hopeful this information will help someone!
reviews.author: Rick King

reviews.text: Absolutely love the pool. Thank you for making this the best activity for our Dusty. The hot tub is his favorite spot.
reviews.author: Dustin Davis

reviews.text: We are enjoying a beautiful, fun, custom pool by King Pools. We envisioned something unique, yet functional,  that all would enjoy effortlessly with us from our grown kids and grandchildren, to our great grandparents, friends, etc..(ages 7 months to 91 years)!  Our older home is a ranch style design on a large multi level lawn that required creativity to aesthetically place the pool in the existing footprint.  Ron worked with us and designed a cool pool featuring a beach entry, hot tub, sheer water descent, bubblers, ledges and a cool deck. He was a great communicator and contractor throughout the process which honestly included occasional weather and vendor delays. But, we always felt that we knew what was happening and King Pools was responsive to our inquiries. The result is an amazing and versatile entertainment pool that offers something for everyone from relaxing on the beach entry or in the hot tub to swimming laps and burning a lot of energy from having so much fun together!
reviews.author: Paula Cook

reviews.text:
This summer was nothing short of magical, all thanks to the incredible backyard oasis crafted by King's Pool! 🏊‍♂️🌺 We can't express enough how appreciative we are for their outstanding work.

From the initial vision to the final splash, working with King's Pool was an absolute delight. Their dedication, expertise, and attention to detail turned our backyard dreams into a reality. 👏💦

A huge shoutout to the amazing team at King's Pool for transforming our space into a haven of relaxation and joy. If you're thinking about creating your own oasis, look no further!
reviews.author: William Young

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic, depicting a typical contractor experience with a strong majority of satisfied customers and a few detailed, credible complaints. The company has a good BBB record for handling issues. The negative review is specific and concerning, but isolated among the provided samples and countered by detailed positive experiences.

Detailed positive reviews mentioning family members (Ron, Kim, son) and specific interactions
Varied writing styles and emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
Positive reviews acknowledge and counter specific negative claims (contractor friendliness)
BBB A+ rating with no complaints listed suggests effective resolution of issues
